title: Grey & Pink Tie-Dye Cotton Kurta Pant Dupatta Set
color_custom: Charcoal grey with diagonal pink tie-dye bands & pink pants
description:
Barkha means rain – soft grey like a monsoon sky, with bright streaks of pink running through it.

A charcoal-grey cotton kurta crossed by two bold diagonal bands of pink, white and grey tie-dye. The round neckline has a small notch at the front, the cut is sleeveless and straight, with side slits that make it easy to move in. It comes with pink cotton pants and a grey cotton dupatta tie-dyed with pink-and-white stripes and circle motifs.

✦ The Details
• Round neckline with a front notch
• Sleeveless, straight kurta with side slits, calf length
• Two diagonal tie-dye bands in pink, white and grey
• Straight pink cotton pants
• Grey cotton dupatta with pink-and-white tie-dye stripes and circles

✦ Fabric & Craft
Soft, breathable cotton for all-day comfort. Tie-dye is made by tying the fabric before dyeing, so the bands are never exactly the same twice – every piece is a little different.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular fit. Choose your usual size or use our Fit Finder. Between sizes? Size up – or send us your bust, waist and hip and we will stitch it to your measurements.

✦ How to Style It
Oxidised silver jhumkas and clear heels for a day out; flat juttis and a cross-body bag for office or college. Throw the dupatta over one shoulder so the circle motifs show.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia – duties & taxes included, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

Every tie-dye piece is unique – the pattern and colour vary slightly from piece to piece, and that is part of its charm. The colour may also look slightly different on your screen.
care: Hand wash separately in cold water – tie-dye may bleed a little in the first few washes. Do not bleach or soak. Dry inside out in shade and iron on medium heat.
